translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Israa'eeliyaa Asay S'oossaa Ogiyaa Kaallibeenna
Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, taani Israa'eeliyaa asaw ta kumentsaa wozanaappe amottiyaawenne S'oossaa woossiyaawe unttunttu attanaassa;
ayaw gooppe, unttunttu S'oossaw ootsanaw loytsi koyyiyaawaa taani markkattay; shin unttunttu S'oossaw ootsanaw loytsi koyyiyaa koshshay tumu eratetsaappe gidenna.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay asaa s'illissiyaa ogiyaa unttunttu erennaan, barenttu huup'e s'illotetsaa essanaw koyyeeddino; k'ay barenttu huup'ew S'oossay asaa s'illissiyaa ogew eeno gibeykkino.
Ayaw gooppe, ammaneedda ubbay s'illanaadan, Kiristtoosi higgiyaa k'ofaa poleedda.
Atotetsay Ubbaassa
Asay higgew azazettiide s'illiyaabaw Muse, «Higgii azaziyaawaa ootsiyaa ooninne he higgiyan pas'a de'ana» yaagi s'aafeedda;
shin ammanuwaan s'illiyaabaw geetetteeddawe hawaa; «Ne wozanaan, ‹Ooni saluwaa pude baanee?› gooppa. Hewe Kiristtoosa duge wotsanaassa;
woy ‹Duge sa'aa garssa wod'd'anawe oonee?› gooppa. Hewe Kiristtoosa hayk'uwaappe dentsanaassa.
Shin I giyaawe hawaa; ‹S'oossaa k'aalay ne mataana; ne doonaaninne ne wozanaan de'ee› geetetteedda» yaagee. Hewekka nuuni hinttenttoo odiyaa ammanuwaa k'aalaa.
Neeni, «Yesuusi Godaa» gaade ne doonaan markkattooppe, k'ay S'oossay hayk'uwaappe Aa dentseeddawaa ne wozanaan ammanooppe, neeni attana.
Ayaw gooppe, Asay bare wozanaan ammaniide s'illee; bare doonaankka markkattiide attee.
S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Aan ammaniyaa ooninne yeellatenna» yaagee.
Ayihuda asaanne Ayihuda gidenna asaa giddon dummatetsay baawa. Itti S'oossay ubbaa Godaa; I barena s'eesiyaa ubbatoo daro keeka.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Godaa suntsaa s'eesiyaa ooninne attana» yaagee.

Yaatina, unttunttu Aa ammanibeennawantta gidooppe, wooti Aa s'eesanaw danddayiinoo? K'ay k'aalaa sisibeennawanttu waan ammananaw danddayiinoo? K'aalaa odiyaawe d'ayooppe, unttunttu waan sisanaw danddayiinoo?
K'ay k'aalaa odiyaawanttu kiitettennan aggooppe, oosuu wooti odettanaw danddayii? Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Nashechchiyaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaawanttu yuussay wooti lo"ii!» yaagee.
Shin unttunttu ubbay wonggalaw azazettibeykkino; ayaw gooppe Isiyaasi, «Ta Godaw, nuuni markkatteeddawaa ooni ammaneeddee?» yaageedda.
Simmi Asay k'aalaa sisiide ammanee; k'ay itti uray Kiristtoosa k'aalaa, odina sisee.
Shin unttunttu k'aalaa sisibeennawe tumee gaade taani oochchay. Tuma unttunttu siseeddino; S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaageedda.
Shin Israa'eeliyaa asatuu eribeykkinoyee gaade taani oochchay. Muse kase,

content.text: k'ay eeyaa asatuwaan taani hinttentta hank'k'etsissana»

content: yaageedda.
K'ay Isiyaasi daro s'aliide,
yaagee.
Shin Israa'eelatuwaabaa I haasayiidde,
yaagee.
